description: The public Zenodo Sinking City release assembles spatial indicators for DKI Jakarta, Indonesia, over approximately 2015–2024. Its file inventory separates land subsidence, vegetation index, built-up index, impervious surface area and residential-area proportion into five ZIP archives. The article describes Sentinel-1 radar processing with LiCSBAS for subsidence and satellite-derived morphology measures used to examine flooding and uneven urban exposure. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0. These are derived spatial surfaces and indicators, not direct continuous measurements of every foundation or a working drainage-network model. Satellite processing choices, variable year coverage and the difference between ground movement and building damage are limitations for parcel-scale infrastructure risk. A reviewer-assessed use is overlaying subsidence and imperviousness with assets in urban flood simulations. data-copernicus-european-ground-motion-service is a related ground-motion resource but covers Europe, not Jakarta, and no processing equivalence was tested. No imagery archive was downloaded.
